scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev --workspace @kanal/server" "npm run dev --workspace @kanal/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @kanal/server && npm run build --workspace @kanal/client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'public', { recursive: true });"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @kanal/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @kanal/client
